paper_title: Comparative analysis of the bronchoalveolar microbiome in Portuguese patients with different chronic lung disorders
skip_reason: No healthy control group. The paper explicitly states 'No healthy controls were collected due to bronchoscopy invasiveness and risk of complications.' All comparisons are between disease groups only: lung cancer (LC) vs. non-LC patients (a heterogeneous group with various respiratory conditions, not healthy controls), and LC* vs. COPD vs. ILD (all chronic lung disease groups). The qualification criterion requires at least one disease group compared against a healthy control, which is absent here.
primary_disease: chronic lung disorders (lung cancer, COPD, interstitial lung disease)
